Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh strange phenomenon, tell me why you keep making my brothers' inventions disappear! Give me a sign! (Looks to her left with her left eye and vice versa. She smacks the floor, and a book wobbles off the shelf) Ugh! Why do you toy with me? (Picks up the book) My 4th grade science book? (Opens the book) "The scientific method has proven to be mankind's most useful tool for understanding the truth behind formerly strange phenomenon". Hee-hee-hee-hee...

Name: Linda
Dialog: You boys ready for pie tonight?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Doonkelberry Pie! Our favorite!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (Arranging the groceries into a shelf) No, not Doonkelberry Pie. Everybody's out of Doonkelberries! I can't find them anywhere lately.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Really? (Starts typing on his laptop) Let me check.

Name: Linda
Dialog: I'll be berry interested to see what you find.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Good one, Mom. (At Ferb) We should cast our net a little wider than Danville. (The laptop beeps) Bingo! (Looks closer to the screen) It looks like there are some in... Drusselstein!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Drusselstein is a rustic Eastern European country, whose primary export is Doonkelberries.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today! Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good morning, Agent P, and welcome to the field test of our new talking letter. As you can see, it looks like a normal letter, except for this strange gibberish text that no one can read, and the obvious fact that it's got a little talking photo of-- Actually, this is a silly idea. I mean, we had to mail this last Tuesday. Plus, it's really just dumb-lucked that no one has picked up the mail first. Well, whatever. Open the box, Agent P.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: That's right, rockenhosen! We're sending you to Drusselstein. Doofenshmirtz will arrive there this morning, and we must know what he's up to. Now this letter will self-destruct. (The envelope closes, and the letter self destructs) Oww!! Oh, and the, uh, box, as well. (Perry picks up the scattered shreds of the blown up letter, puts it into the box, closes it and tosses the box out of the pet door) 5, 4, 3... (Perry changes into his clothes and runs off) You know, I really don't know what we were thinking with -- (The second explosion occurs. The roof opens and Perry comes out in his jet-pack)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey Phineas! What'cha dooooin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're gonna build a trebuchet to shoot ourselves to Europe.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Cool! Gravity or tension spring?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, gravity proba-- Wait, when did you learn trebuchet mechanics?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Medieval Siege Engine Patch. It was my first one.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Clears throat) I'm looking for a book on scientific investigation and disappearing objects. Got anything?

Name: Librarian
Dialog: Let's see... (Starts typing on the computer) Um, Disappearing Objects and Scientific Investigation. Sound good?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Shuh!

Name: Librarian
Dialog: Oh, it's checked out to a Heinz Doofenshmirtz.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Yes?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Vanessa?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: "Doofenshmirtz". It's my last name. Heinz is my Dad.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Doofenshmirtz? What's that, like, Chinese?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: It's Drusselsteinian.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Right, from Drusselsteinia!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: I'm heading over my Dad's house if you want to look for your book.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Cool.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And this is it, right here. (Gets off) Thanks for the ride! Keep the change!

Name: Driver
Dialog: Vhat change? You've been hitchhiking!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's an expression! Hmm! (At Perry) Perry the Platypus? Wow, Rumpkinhossen'. Five seconds and you've already gone native. Well, don't worry, I'm not doing anything evil today, I'm just here to renew my driver's license. (Shows his license) Say, as long as you're here, why don't you stay and keep me company? (pause) Pleeease? It's so boring. (Perry facepalms)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: You know, traditionally, these things don't have much range.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, it's a bit of a cheat to use a warp generator to bend the fabric of space, but I'm sure they would've done it in olden times if the technology were available.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: If the trebuchet can't go to Drusselstein, bring Drusselstein to the trebuchet!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Baljeet?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Bending!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hmm! Rustic! (notices Zengle's Fruit Stand) Here it is! This may be the only place in the world to get doonkelberries right now.

Name: Zengle
Dialog: That's because I have my own doonkelberry field. So when I need more, I pick more.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But what about exports?

Name: Zengle
Dialog: Well...the canning facilities shut down after the shaft stopped working.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The shaft?

Name: Zengle
Dialog: All of Drusselstein runs off of central shaft. Or at least...it used to. Drusselstein's a long narrow land, the only country in the world where a central shaft makes any sense, except for maybe Chile. At the end of the shaft was an exercise wheel powered by thousands of rabbits. The rabbits turned the wheel, the wheel turned the shaft, and the shaft turned everything else. A miracle of 16th Century science, today! It powered our vashing machines, our blenders, our schwingel presses, and of course, it ran all of the country's doonkelberry processing plants. The rabbits wouldn't keep up, so we decided to upgrade from rabbits to a more powerful source of energy

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But the solution is so obvious!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Just have one side turn their goats around.

Name: Zengle
Dialog: Yes, but we are a proud people. In our culture, turning your goats around is the mark of a coward! Neither side will back down. So it is, such as it has ever been, in Drusselstein, Land...of...the Shaft! I am done, now.

Name: Zengle
Dialog: Uh-oh. Time for the 5 o'clock demonstrations.

Name: Man 1
Dialog: Counterclockwise forever!

Name: Man 2
Dialog: Turn around!

Name: Man 3
Dialog: We cannot be swayed!

Name: Man 4
Dialog: You're turning the wrong way!

Name: Man 5
Dialog: Rightsiders go home!

Name: Man 6
Dialog: Filthy clockwisers!

Name: Woman 1
Dialog: Yo mama!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Isabella, how would you like a Conflict Resolution patch?

Name: Receptionist
Dialog: Fill out this form and take it to line 26. (goat bleats) NEXT! Yes?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I want to renew my driver's license, please.

Name: Receptionist
Dialog: (inspects the license) Hmm...

Name: Doofenshmirts
Dialog: "Hmm"? What do you mean "Hmm"?

Name: Receptionist
Dialog: I'm afraid you will have to be... (inhale) RE-CERTIFIED!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Re-certified? No, but that means...

Name: Receptionist
Dialog: YES!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No!

Name: Receptionist
Dialog: You vill have to take...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Don't say it!

Name: Receptionist
Dialog: THE DRIVING TEST!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: B-but t-there must be some mistake! I --

Name: Receptionist
Dialog: Your instructor will meet you out BACK! NEXT!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hold my hand, Perry the Platypus! (sniff) I'm scared!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Why are you singing that?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: It's just something we do.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, swanky! It's all like, science-y in here.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Yeah, my dad's kind of an amateur inventor. I think I saw some books over here. (sees books cluttered with lasers on a table) Oh, here we go. Uh, we can just put his other stuff anywhere. What's the name of the book again?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, "Disappearing Objects

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Disappearing objects? You mean, like socks?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Like rollercoasters, building to the moon, stampeding cows...stuff like that just disappears.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Does that happen often?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, you would not believe.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, let's recap. You Leftsiders won't turn your goats around?

Name: Left judge
Dialog: I believe we have made our position clear.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And you Righsiders won't turn your goats around, either.

Name: Right judge
Dialog: This point is non-negotiable!

Name: Judges/Drusselstenians
Dialog: There is only one point! There is only one point! We will never turn! (keep arguing)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Now, wait a minute, wait a minute, wait a minute. I think we can solve this, but we're gonna need a certain tool.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wow, this place is just made for scientific inquiry. (spots telescope) Hey, cool telescope! (looks through it) I bet I can see my house from here. Oh, cool, it's pointed right at it! (sees trebuchet in backyard) What the heck is that? Oh, my gosh. It's another stupid invention. (patting telescope) Thank you, Mr. Scientific Instrument.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Thanks for coming along, Perry the Platypus. You know, having you around just makes me feel, you know, safer. In this circumstance, Back home is exactly the opposite.

Name: Driving instructor
Dialog: Heinz Doofenshmirtz, do you attest hat you take this driving test of your own free will?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes.

Name: Driving instructor
Dialog: You may go!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh, wait, wait, uh, I'm not ready. Let, let me psych myself up. Just a few breathing exercises, then I'll go, okay, right?

Name: Driving instructor
Dialog: We have a choker!

Name: Female Pedestrian
Dialog: I'm okay!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I think I did okay.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ladies and gentlemen, after careful consideration, we have come up with a solution that we believe will satisfy everyone.

Name: Male Leftsider 1
Dialog: We will not be satisfied!

Name: Male Rightsider 1
Dialog: No compromise!

Name: Male Rightsider 2
Dialog: No compromise!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb?

Name: Man 7
Dialog: I did not think it was possible!

Name: Woman 2
Dialog: The shaft is turning in both directions!

Name: Viking
Dialog: The science is far behyond us!

Name: Man 8
Dialog: The viking is right! By separating the shaft, you have united our country!

Name: Man 9
Dialog: Your goats may walk in any direction you choose, Father!

Name: Man 9's father
Dialog: Yours too, my son! (both sob)

Name: Man 10
Dialog: It's like a fluganoff miracle!

Name: Man 8
Dialog: You have brought peace to our land. Surely there's something we can do for you?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes. Yes, there is.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Fresh doonkleberries! Thanks!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (on phone) Okay, Baljeet!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I guess it's lucky that they had a trebuchet in Drusselstein, huh?

Name: Man 11
Dialog: Henceforth we shall call this day; "Phineas and Ferb" Day!

Name: Man 12
Dialog: You mean "Ferb and Phineas" Day!

Name: Man 13
Dialog: By descending order of height! Everybody knows that!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (singsong) Hello, Mom! I bet you can't guess why I'm calling!

Name: Linda
Dialog: I don't know. Did the boys build a giant amusement park for leprechauns?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (singsong) I don't know if that's what it is! But if you simply look in the backyard, you'll see it!!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (singsong) All right, Candace. I'm looking.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (from the phone) And surprise, there's nothing there.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Huh? (looks through the telescope) What do you mean, "Nothing"?! (sees nothing) But...but but...

Name: Candace
Dialog: (flatly) Thanks, Vanessa.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: What about the scientific method?

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's flawed.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Thanks for everything, Perry the Platypus. And don't worry, I - I'll pay for the dry cleaning on your Rumpkinhossen. All right, see you back home! I'm taking the trebuchet. (Perry blasts away on a jetpack)

Name: Linda
Dialog: (offscreen) More pie, anyone?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No thanks, Mom. Delicious, but I'm stuffed.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Me too!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (offscreen) I think it's gonna rain. It's really overcast out there.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nah, that's just Drusselstein.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Baljeet?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, sorry!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I should always travel like this! This is gre --

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: CURSE YOU, CONCEPTUAL ELASTICITY OF SPACE-TIME!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I think I did okay.
